props.text: Import this project, then open Gateway Settings in Designer or Settings in Projects as an administrator. Search for Gateway operations in the application inventory and reopen this Designer from its resource link.
Publish the project and open its operator link. Engineering and operator sign-ins appear as separate sessions. Use only a disposable session for the revocation exercise in the guide.
Open Diagnostics, refresh the snapshot and inspect process memory, available disk and bounded API observations. Download the support JSON and verify that project contents and credentials are absent.

Open Deployment in Gateway Settings. Compare observed listeners, startup values and saved listener settings. Edit a local HTTP port, choose Validate draft, then Discard draft and reload. Validation does not save or restart. Saving and recovery are separate exercises for a disposable gateway in the guide.
